key_insight: Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging replaces uniform ensemble voting with a sparse probability distribution learned on the simplex, so only the most competent base models retain weight.
engineering_relevance: The method is model-agnostic and can compress bagged ensembles dramatically, reducing inference cost while improving calibration without sacrificing accuracy.
method: Minimize OOB loss over ensemble weights constrained to the probability simplex
Replace ineffective L1 sparsity with a concave quadratic penalty to enable pruning
Post-train prune and reweight bagging models for calibrated sparse inference
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 96% ensemble compression with linear inference speedups, lower Expected Calibration Error, and preserved or improved generalization accuracy.
watch_item: Optimization on the simplex with a nonconvex quadratic sparsity penalty may require careful tuning and can be sensitive to local minima or OOB estimate quality.
paper_title: Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging: Transitioning from Uniform Priors to Sparse Posteriors in Ensemble Learning
